survey.submit.statement: INSERT INTO answers (response_key, question, answer, submitted_at) SELECT ?1, j.key, CAST(j.value AS TEXT), ?3 FROM json_each(?2) AS j WHERE json_type(?2) = 'object' AND j.key IN ('role', 'team_size', 'comment') AND length(CAST(j.value AS TEXT)) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

survey.tally.statement: SELECT question, answer, count(*) AS responses FROM answers WHERE question IN ('role', 'team_size') GROUP BY question, answer ORDER BY question, responses DESC LIMIT 100

ballots.cast.statement: INSERT INTO ballots (user_id, choice) VALUES (?1, ?2) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING
